note: Anything in hand is a weapon (Dave 19 Nov 2026 play test: "I just tried to hit a pig with an axe and it is doing no damage"; "any thing in your hand should be able to be used as a weapon"). A left click with the item in hand at an animal in reach strikes it (server_items.gd _strike). An item with items.json damage strikes for that (spears, swords, maces: unchanged). Any other item strikes for its class here: a tool by its tool_class (key tool_<class>), plus tier_step for each tier above base_tier (Stone and Copper are tier 2, Steel 5); a weapon with no damage (a shield, a sling) for weapon_no_damage; anything else (food, a stone, a stick) for other. mode is the damage mode an armoured animal reads (items.json damage_mode words). reach_m is how far the blow reaches (a weapon with no reach_m of its own: MeleeRules.WEAPON_REACH_M, 3 m). All numbers PROVISIONAL MELEE-1 (picked 19 Nov 2026 against animal health in data/animals/animals.json: rabbit 5, deer 20, wolf 30, boar 40, bear 120; a Stone spear does 8): a Stone axe takes a boar in six blows, a Steel axe in four.

bare_hand.note: A punch with nothing in hand (Dave 23 Nov 2026), times the Hand to hand skill factor (skills.json action punch: 1.0 at skill 1 up to max_factor 2.0): 2 to 4 a blow, a rabbit in two or three. PROVISIONAL.
